items.claim: Deliz is 38 years old and declining.
items.quote: I think the Lindsay is on his way out. He's 38 years old. He does not look the same.

items.claim: Deliz is moving back up to light heavyweight.
items.quote: He's moving back up to light heavyweight.

items.claim: Ritter will be the much bigger and better fighter.
items.quote: Ditter is going to be the much bigger guy here, and he's be the much better fighter in general.

items.claim: Deliz fights with low volume in his striking.
items.quote: Dind's low volume. I think Ditter might actually be the minute winner in the distance striking because Deli is just not throwing anything.

items.claim: Ritter is a very good grappler compared to Deliz.
items.quote: Dij is a good grappler, but I think Ditter is a very, very, very good grappler.

items.claim: Ritter has horrible cardio generally, but still has better cardio than Deliz in this matchup.
items.quote: I think Ditter's cardio is horrible, but I think he might have the better cardio here.

items.claim: Ritter has a lot more left in the tank than Deliz.
items.quote: I think he's got a lot more left in the tank as well.
